mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic contraction that typically prompts Federal Reserve rate cuts, compressing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with INDPRO decline, or correlation between INDPRO decline and positive returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals severe economic contraction that triggers aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE rise and INDPRO fall, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS declining), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals policy ineffectiveness and persistent weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS declining and UNRATE rising, or negative return effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals robust housing market activity that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with HOUST > 1200, or correlation with positive returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer and housing demand, which together indicate improving economic conditions and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not positive in more than 60% of months with RSAFS rise and HOUST rise, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation that typically leads to expectations of tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL rise, or negative return effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index base 2017=100), it signals severe economic contraction that triggers aggressive policy responses, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with INDPRO < 100, or positive return effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
